We miss our own support SLA more often than we'd like: in 2025, 38% of tickets got a late first reply and 20% were resolved late — urgent tickets fared worst, missing resolution half the time (50.6%).

Customer happiness tracks almost perfectly with speed: average satisfaction drops from 4.4/5 on tickets resolved within 4 hours to 1.7/5 on tickets that take over a week — so faster replies are the single biggest lever on CSAT.

Support pain is concentrated, not spread evenly: just 3 of our ~94 merchants (Cragsley Outfitters, Marrowby & Vane, Studio Vrij) generate 34% of all support tickets, and these same merchants have the worst response times in the whole book.
